name: Landing Page Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Audit Prompt Template
systemPrompt: You are a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Behavioral UX Specialist. Evaluate post-click landing page friction, message match, mobile usability, and checkout funnel drops.
userPromptTemplate:
Analyze the landing page experience for: {{landing_page_url}}

Context:
- Industry: {{industry}}
- Current CVR: {{current_cvr}}%
- Target CVR: {{target_cvr}}%
- Mobile Traffic Share: {{mobile_traffic_percent}}%

Provide:
1. Above-the-Fold Value Proposition & Message Match Analysis
2. Mobile Friction Points & Core Web Vitals Recommendations
3. Social Proof, Trust Signals & Objection Handling Gaps
4. Top 3 High-Impact A/B Testing Hypotheses
